2027-06-01.title: Lose Yourself
2027-06-01.verse: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life because of me and because of the gospel will save it.
2027-06-01.observation: We are taught by culture that we must live for ourselves and do all we can to "find ourselves." Jesus says the opposite. He says we are to turn our lives over to His rule and follow Him by following His Word. Only then can we experience true and lasting freedom.
2027-06-01.application: What do I need to turn over to Him?
2027-06-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the honor of trusting You with every area of our lives.

2027-06-02.title: All Things Are Possible
2027-06-02.verse: Then Jesus said to him, “‘If you are able?’ All things are possible for the one who believes.
2027-06-02.observation: We can do anything and everything God wants us to do. We have to be sure not to look at this verse in a selfish way. He is not saying all things are possible for our selfish desires. He is saying all things are possible when in pursuit of His desires.
2027-06-02.application: Are my desires aligned with His? If so, look out!
2027-06-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for having more than enough power for any obstacle we face.

2027-06-03.title: Serve
2027-06-03.verse: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
2027-06-03.observation: The King of kings gave us a powerful and hard template to follow. He said we should serve others, just like He did. That is hard to do. It's hard to find the boundaries of healthy service. It's hard to serve stupid people. lol. It's hard to not want people to serve us. However, if Jesus did it, we can too.
2027-06-03.application: Who can I serve today for God's glory?
2027-06-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a pattern to follow, then walking with us along the way.

2027-06-04.title: Take God's Help
2027-06-04.verse: For this reason I tell you, whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
2027-06-04.observation: Jesus gives us a promise. He says that when we are walking in His will and ways, nothing will be denied to us. We have to be careful because we can sometimes take this verse out of context and think it means we can indulge our desires. The meaning is He will not deny His children anything they need to do His will.
2027-06-04.application: What am I trying to do without God's help?
2027-06-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for empowering us with all we need to make a difference.

2027-06-05.title: Love Others
2027-06-05.verse: The second is: ‘.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.
2027-06-05.observation: Soooooo hard. I love that God gave us more commandments on how to love our neighbor than on how to love Him. It's easier to love God than to love our neighbor. I'm thankful He gets that and helps us.
2027-06-05.application: Where do I need to grow in my love for others?
2027-06-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a pattern to love our neighbor by how You love us.

2027-06-06.title: Wake Up
2027-06-06.verse: What I say to you I say to everyone: Stay alert!
2027-06-06.observation: The disciples are tired. They are weary. They have a heavy day. Still, Jesus tells them to stay awake. I'm thankful for the warnings of God, even if they are hard.
2027-06-06.application: Where do I need to heed God's warning?
2027-06-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for telling us where to be careful.

2027-06-07.title: God Gets Us
2027-06-07.verse: Stay awake and pray that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
2027-06-07.observation: God gets us. He sees their hearts. He sees they want to be faithful, but they are struggling. A bad king would say they are useless and helpless. Our King said, "I get it."
2027-06-07.application: Where do I need to accept God's mercy?
2027-06-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your mercy.

2027-06-08.title: Recognize God
2027-06-08.verse: Now when the centurion, who stood in front of him, saw how he died, he said, “Truly this man was God’s Son!
2027-06-08.observation: Even a Roman centurion recognized Jesus’ true identity at the cross.
2027-06-08.application: I will live today acknowledging Jesus as Lord and Savior.
2027-06-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for dying for us. We confess You as the Son of God.

2027-06-09.title: Go For It
2027-06-09.verse: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
2027-06-09.observation: Jesus gives His followers the mission to share His good news everywhere.
2027-06-09.application: I will intentionally share God’s love and truth with someone this week.
2027-06-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the hope we have in You. Give us boldness and opportunities to share it.
